title: A transcript rewritten shorter (compaction), then appended
policy: P12: usage already counted stays counted when a transcript is rewritten or deleted. A rebuild of the cache can only count what is still on disk, so it drops A and B: totals after a rebuild can be lower than before it.
derivation: A [100, 50], B [200, 20], C [300, 30] = 700. The file is rewritten as C only: still 700. D [5, 5] appended: 710, 4 operations. A fresh index of the final file (C D): [305, 35] = 340, 2 operations.
